content: Xɨka xewitɨ 'ukaxeiyarieni mɨkitɨ
»Xɨka xaɨtsie Yawé xekakaɨyari mɨxeyetuirieni kwieyaritsie xekwie mayanikɨ xewitɨ mɨkitɨ hetaxeiyarieni, xɨka 'atsixekatehetimani kemɨ'ane miimi,
'ukirawetsixi meta 'itsɨkate mepuhu mepiti'inɨata mɨki manuka kemetetewa kiekarite 'ahurawa mamanetɨkatsie.
Hikɨ 'ukirawetsixi kemɨ'ane kiekari 'ahurawa mɨki manuka mukumatsie kiekatari xeime tsikeru mekaniwiyakuni, hatsuaku mɨkatita'uximayatawe mɨkatakwietsanawe.
Mepenuhana xaɨtsie mayeweritsie hatsuaku kwietsanarita mɨka'ayeiwetsie meta mɨkatiwaka 'iteɨtsiewetsie, meta haa yarexuawekaku, muwapaitɨ kɨipieya mepuwamura.

'Ana mawari wewiwamete rewitsixi mana mepɨneniereni yu'uximayatsika memaye'atɨanikɨ, Yawé xekakaɨyari mɨwaranayexei mɨkɨ kemɨtitewakɨ hetsienamieme teɨteri 'aixɨa memuwayuriekakɨ, meta yamemɨte'uximayakakɨ mɨkɨ memɨte'akanɨtsanikɨ kepauka 'imieri muxuawe meta 'inawari.
Hikɨ yunaitɨ 'ukirawetsixi kiekari 'ahurawa mukumatsie kiekatari mɨki manukatsie, mɨkɨ mepɨtimaimani wakaxi kɨipieya muwamurarie hetsie,
hikɨ 'ana mɨpaɨ heitseriemekɨ mepɨtiyuani: “Tame 'ikɨ xuriya tepɨka'utayeuri, meta tepɨka'unenierixɨ 'ikɨ mɨyamɨtiuyɨ.
Yawé, ketiniwareuyehɨwirieka 'ixaheritsixi 'ateɨterima, mɨkɨ pemɨwaruxɨnaxɨ, meta mɨkɨ wahetsie pepɨkarahɨpani 'atsikatiyuruwame xuriyaya mutayeuriyakɨ”.
Mɨpaɨ 'ekɨ 'atsikatiyuruwame xuriyaya mutayeuriya 'ahetsie mɨrahɨiwa 'akwieyaritsie pepɨrakumaweriya, mɨpaɨ xɨka petiuyurieni 'aixɨa pepɨtiyurieni Yawé hɨxie.
'Uka pɨretsutɨme kemɨtiutiwitɨni
»Kepauka xemayekɨne xeheuyukwiyuka memɨxe'aye'unie wahetsɨa, xɨka Yawé xekakaɨyari wayetuani xemɨwara'iwakɨ, hikɨ xɨka pɨretsutsixi xewarayeitɨani yayupaɨmeme,
xɨka xewitɨ xeime 'uka mupɨretsu 'inakeni, mitiwitɨni pɨyɨweni 'ɨyaya mayanikɨ.
Penuwitɨni yukie, yapɨtita'aitɨani muyukaxinikɨ, yuxɨtete manutixitexɨanikɨ,

meta pɨretsu kemariyari ke'anutihɨna. 'Arike 'akie mɨixa 'ukaiku, meta tihayewayuri yuhiwerietɨ yupaapa yumaama wahekɨ 'ari xeimetseri reutewikaku, 'anake pemitiwitɨni pɨyɨweni, 'ekɨ kɨnaya pepɨhɨkɨtɨni mɨkɨta 'a'ɨya.
Peru xɨka 'arike kamatsi'unake, pepipitɨani mɨkɨ tsepa hakewa metɨa. Pɨkayɨweni pemituani meta ti'a'uximayatsiriwame hepaɨ pemiyurieneni, mɨkɨtsɨ pemitixani'eri kanayani.
Mexɨakame heitserie kemɨrexeiya

»Nepɨxetaxatɨani xewitɨ 'uki yuhutame yu'ɨitama mɨwarexeiya, xeime xeikɨa waɨkawa mɨnaki'erie, xeimeta pɨkanaki'erie, yuhutame wahetsie tɨɨri pɨwarayexei, matsi 'uka mɨkanaki'erietsie meri nunutsi mexɨakame kaniutinuiwa.

Kepauka 'ikɨ tewi yuniwema mɨtiwatapitɨani yupiinite, pɨkayɨweni 'uka mɨnaki'erietsie mieme pɨta mɨtikupitɨwani tita mexɨakame hetsie mɨtimiemetɨkai, meta yuniwe mexɨakame yatipaɨmeme xeikɨa pɨkatikupitɨwani, tatsɨari, yu'ɨya waɨkawa mɨkanaki'erietsie mieme.

Matsi pɨta mɨkɨ mexɨakame kehayeitɨwani heitserie kemɨrexeiya mexɨakametɨtɨ, hikɨ 'ikɨ mexɨakame pɨtipitɨani 'anatekame matsi tawari hepaɨna paɨmeme ketita hetsiena mɨtimieme. Mɨkɨ wamatsika kanihɨkɨtɨni matɨari meyexei, mɨkɨ heitserie kanexeiyani mexɨakame mɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ meta tita hetsiena mɨtimieme pɨtipiinieya.
Xewitɨ raniwe xɨka 'axatiuka'iyarini
»Xɨka xewitɨ yuniwe hexeiyani 'axatiuka'iyarime katiyu'aitɨarinɨakame, yupaapa meta yumaama, xɨka kawareu'enieka kepauka memiheitseritɨa,
paapaya meta maamaya kiekari kitenie mepenuwitɨni, 'ukirawetsixi wahetsɨa mepitaxata.
Hikɨ paapamama 'ukirawetsixi mɨpaɨ mepɨtewatahɨawe: “'Ikɨ taniwe pɨkaheu'ena 'axapɨtiuka'iyari, kemɨtinake xeikɨa pɨtiyuriene meta pɨtawekame. Pɨkatatsi heu'enie”.

Hikɨ 'ana yunaitɨ 'ukitsi mana kiekaritsie kiekatari me'itituaxatɨ tetexikɨ mekanimiekuni. Mɨpaɨ xepɨtehekumaweriya 'axamɨti'ane 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie. Hikɨ yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi mepɨtetamarieni meta mepɨtimamani.
Waɨkawa 'aitsikate
»Xɨka xewitɨ hetsiena rahɨiyayu 'axatiuyurieka 'ukawiyani,

kaxarieya kɨyetsie 'uyewiekame xepɨka'uku'e'eiriwani tɨkarikɨ, matsi mɨkɨ tukaritsie xekeneukateuki. Karikɨ xewitɨ kepauka kɨyetsie muyewiyani mɨkɨ tewi Kakaɨyari 'axakaniyurieka. Ka'itiyakame kwie xepɨka'ayeitɨaka Yawé xekakaɨyari mɨxeyetuirie xekwie mayanikɨ.
